action.command:
powershell -Command "
# Get current branch
\$branch = git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
\$mainBranch = 'main'

# Get commits not in main
\$commits = git log \$mainBranch..\$branch --pretty=format:'%s'

# Get changed files
\$changedFiles = git diff --name-only \$mainBranch..HEAD

# Generate title from branch name and commits
\$branchTitle = \$branch -replace '^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test)/', '' -replace '-', ' '
\$firstCommit = (\$commits | Select-Object -First 1)
\$title = if (\$firstCommit) { \$firstCommit } else { 'Update: ' + \$branchTitle }

# Show summary
Write-Host '=== PR Info ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host \"Branch: \$branch\" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host \"Title: \$title\" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host \"Changed files: \$(\$changedFiles.Count)\" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Creating PR...' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Create PR with template
gh pr create --title \"\$title\" --template .github/templates/pull-request.md --base \$mainBranch

if (\$LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
  Write-Host 'PR created successfully!' -ForegroundColor Green
  exit 0
} else {
  Write-Host 'Error creating PR' -ForegroundColor Red
  exit 1
}
"
